candidate: H53a global sign chord plus node-private binary Schur-product capacity ceiling

parent_evidence.causal_transition: H52's robust objective removes the PC1 collapse but eight global orientations plus diagonal DCT carriers recover only 2.54 percent. Replace the narrow node-private diagonal action with two directly learned binary low-rank fields whose Schur product has generic rank up to r squared, while retaining one charged global chord.

scientific_question: Can a sub-one-percent global-chord/private-Schur decoder cover every top-16 direction of all six 239-state MLP paths without a stored empirical basis or dense shadow?

frozen_inventory.pca_centering: independent mean of all 239 states for the optimistic capacity ceiling
frozen_inventory.reported_weighting: eigenvalue normalized within each node top-16 set
frozen_inventory.fit_weighting: uniform geometric objective across all six nodes and all 16 PCs

frozen_decoder.weight_formula: W_n=W0_n+alpha_n*S+(U_n1 diag(s_n1) V_n1^T) hadamard (U_n2 diag(s_n2) V_n2^T)
frozen_decoder.seed_weight: exact step-zero matrix, reproducible from matched initialization and not charged as learned state
frozen_decoder.global_chord: one learned 3072x768 Rademacher matrix shared by all 24 MLP endpoints and stored as one bit per value
frozen_decoder.private_factors: for each endpoint, two independent pairs U in signs(3072x35), V in signs(768x35), plus two FP16 rank-amplitude vectors
frozen_decoder.node_global_amplitude: one FP16 scalar alpha per endpoint

continuous_relaxation_ceiling.purpose: necessary topology gate only; not a deployable checkpoint
continuous_relaxation_ceiling.targets: all 96 unit PCs: six nodes times top 16 components
continuous_relaxation_ceiling.temporary_coordinates: independent factor values, amplitudes, and alpha for each target PC; alternative states, not simultaneous deployed state
continuous_relaxation_ceiling.global_chord_fit: one jointly learned bounded real relaxation shared across all 96 targets
continuous_relaxation_ceiling.private_factor_fit: two independently learned bounded real rank-35 factor pairs per target
continuous_relaxation_ceiling.objective: mean over all 96 targets of log(squared_cosine_capture + 1e-4)

binary_stage_if_and_only_if_relaxation_p.factor_projection: sign projection of global chord and all four private factor matrices
binary_stage_if_and_only_if_relaxation_p.refinement: discrete gradient-ranked bit flips plus FP16 amplitude refinement for 64 frozen updates
controls: ordinary equal-bit additive binary low-rank sum
